development_ablation: one D_P replay per development cell, seed0-3 heading-only; seed4-6 tangent+heading+bg; seed7-9 O gate. Each changes one factor from corresponding seed D_P. Report paired within-seed differences separately per ablation, no cross-stratum attribution.
snapshot_selection: seed0 only; sorted union of 30/60/90 second registered checkpoints and first causal baseline suspect-latch episode starts, first10 per cell, valid following20s not required and censoring recorded
snapshot_start: baseline posterior immediately before selected timestamp; identical x/P and future controls for all four arms
snapshot_schedule: common baseline A risk/geometry machine virtual recovery candidate schedule, independent of ground truth and not recomputed by treatment arms
geometry: sum historical H with inverse motion-transition transport to current prior; accepted observations, effective R, two-second trailing window; fixed D4 Schur complement rules
quiet_rule: BASE accepted risk<=.25 continuously for1s; rejected packets reset quiet dwell
monitor_rule: two continuous seconds of accepted quiet risk and geometry, then next episode enabled subject to20s cooldown and route maximum3
episode_schedule: nonrecovery arms consume virtual candidates solely for causal diagnostic schedule; no mean or covariance intervention
no_trigger: retain every cell and record zero events
accuracy_recovery: heading absolute error<=1deg and XY error<=.1m jointly continuously2s; right censor at trace end
endpoint_cohort: common baseline A predicted prior before first snapshot treatment, aligned to truth at the same timestamp, defines already_accurate for all arms; events use each own pre-treatment predicted prior; first emitted errors reported separately
repair_policy: eight fixed short M traces only under GO_S2_REPAIR; immutable original main/ablation outcomes reused, full M and non-M event endpoint tables corrected additively
